name: delegation-pipeline
description: Delegate grunt work from Claude to free/cheap models, so your Claude usage goes to the thinking, not the typing.

plugins.name: delegation-pipeline
plugins.description: The /delegate and /orchestrate commands and skills: offload any diff-verifiable work to free/cheap OpenAI-compatible workers, defaulting to the free tier and escalating to deepseek on failure, verify and commit, then review the diff. Needs the worker binary from install.sh.
